headlines.snippet: After hours of searching, an armed suspect who fled from an olive grove in Kafr Kara was arrested. The suspect was located and apprehended with guidance from the Shin Bet following extensive searches involving police, border police, and helicopters. An M-16 rifle was found hidden in the ground nearby. The suspect has been taken for questioning, and the motive for the incident is still under investigation. Earlier reports indicated the suspect was wearing khaki uniforms and fled after civilians tried to alert him.

He also noted about Netanyahu, "We had good relations and successes."
